ChildLinks.description: API paths for the frontend to follow (SRS FR-DASH-003).
ChildLinks.title: ChildLinks

FeeAmounts.description:
Money over a set of bills, two decimal places. `collected` is the sum of the
payments against those bills, whenever they were made.
FeeAmounts.title: FeeAmounts

FeeCreate.description:
Only these fields are accepted: the receipt number, dates and status are
server-owned.
FeeCreate.title: FeeCreate

FeeOut.description:
A bill with its instalments and refunds, oldest first. `amount_paid` is live
payments less refunds; `amount_refunded` is the refunds alone.
FeeOut.title: FeeOut

FeeSummary.description:
A bill and what has been paid against it. `amount_paid` is the sum of the
payments, never stored; `balance` and `status` come from `services.money`.
FeeSummary.title: FeeSummary

FeeTotals.description: Sums over every bill matching the filters, not just the current page.
FeeTotals.title: FeeTotals

FeesByPeriod.description:
`term` is for the selected term (None when there is no term); `all_time` spans
every term. They are never mixed.
FeesByPeriod.title: FeesByPeriod

HistoryEntry.description:
One event on a bill, so a screen need not merge the payment and refund lists.
A void is its own entry, dated when it happened. `reason` and `by` (the account
email) are for administrators only; everyone else gets null.
HistoryEntry.title: HistoryEntry

LoginRequest.description: Only credentials are accepted: the role always comes from the database.
LoginRequest.title: LoginRequest

ParentLinkCreate.description:
Links an existing parent-role account to a student. The relationship is free
text because the SRS defines no list of values.
ParentLinkCreate.title: ParentLinkCreate

PasswordChange.description: A signed-in user choosing a new password. Passwords are used exactly as sent.
PasswordChange.title: PasswordChange

PasswordResetRequest.description: A reset code, the account's email, and the new password to set.
PasswordResetRequest.title: PasswordResetRequest

PaymentCreate.description: An instalment on an existing bill. The receipt number and date are server-owned.
PaymentCreate.title: PaymentCreate

PublicStats.description:
Headline counts of active records for the public page. Counts only: no names,
ids or other personal data.
PublicStats.title: PublicStats

Receipt.description:
Printable receipt data (SRS FR-FEE-008). A bill receipt is numbered and dated
like the bill; an instalment receipt (`payment` set) like that payment, with the
figures as they stood once it was recorded.
Receipt.title: Receipt

ReceiptSignatures.description: Labels only: the frontend draws blank signature and stamp boxes to print.
ReceiptSignatures.title: ReceiptSignatures

RefundReceipt.description: Printable data for a refund. The bill's figures are as they stand now.
RefundReceipt.title: RefundReceipt

RefundRequest.description: Money to give back against a payment. The receipt number and date are server-owned.
RefundRequest.title: RefundRequest

ResetCodeIssued.description: Shown once, to the administrator. The code cannot be retrieved afterwards.
ResetCodeIssued.title: ResetCodeIssued

ResultRow.description: One score in a class sheet listing.
ResultRow.title: ResultRow

ResultSheet.description: Everything FR-RES-009 lists, for the frontend to render and print.
ResultSheet.title: ResultSheet

ResultWrite.description:
One score for a student, subject and term. Out-of-range or over-precise scores
are rejected, never clamped or rounded.
ResultWrite.title: ResultWrite

StudentCreate.description: Only these fields are accepted: the number, status and flags are server-owned.
StudentCreate.title: StudentCreate

TeacherCreate.description: The teacher record is always linked to an existing teacher-role account.
TeacherCreate.title: TeacherCreate

TeacherOverview.description: "My overview": the teacher's own classes only. No fee or school-wide figures.
TeacherOverview.title: TeacherOverview

UserCreate.description: Administrators are created only through the CLI, never over HTTP.
UserCreate.title: UserCreate

UserStatusUpdate.description: Only the active flag can be changed here.
UserStatusUpdate.title: UserStatusUpdate

UserSummary.description: An account as an administrator sees it in the directory. Never any credential.
UserSummary.title: UserSummary

VoidRequest.description:
Why a payment is being voided. The reason is kept on record and printed nowhere
except for administrators.
VoidRequest.title: VoidRequest

post.description:
Change your own password. Your other sessions end; this one stays. A wrong
current password counts toward the same limit as a wrong sign-in password.

422.description: The current password is wrong (code `incorrect_password`) or the new one is not acceptable.

429.description: Too many wrong passwords; see the Retry-After header.
Too many failed attempts; see the Retry-After header.

post.description:
Set a new password with a one-time code from an administrator. All the account's
sessions end; the user then signs in normally. Every problem with the code looks
the same, and wrong codes are limited like wrong passwords.

422.description: The reset code is not valid (code `invalid_reset_code`, whatever the reason) or the new password is not acceptable.

429.description: Too many wrong codes; see the Retry-After header.

get.description: Active classes the caller may reach: all for admins, assigned ones for teachers.

schema.title: Response List Classes Api V1 Classes Get

get.description:
Per-subject and overall averages. Teachers reach only their assigned classes and
see every subject there; parents get their child's figures via student results.

Role-specific overview for the selected term (default: the current term).
Admins get school-wide figures with fees for the term and for all time, kept
separate. Teachers get "My overview": their own classes only, no fees. Parents get their
linked children.

schema.title: Response Overview Api V1 Dashboard Overview Get

get.description: The fixed list of fee categories.

Admins see every bill; parents only their linked children's. `totals` cover all
bills matching the filters, not just this page.

post.description:
Bill a student, optionally recording a first payment. Amounts are naira with at
most two decimals; the receipt number and dates are assigned by the server.

get.description: One bill with its payments; a parent only gets their own child's.

post.description: Record an instalment. A payment that would exceed the amount billed is refused.

parameters.description: Optional. A unique value (8 to 64 letters, digits, `.`, `_` or `-`) per payment. Send the same value when retrying so a payment is never recorded twice.
parameters.name: idempotency-key

schema.description: Optional. A unique value (8 to 64 letters, digits, `.`, `_` or `-`) per payment. Send the same value when retrying so a payment is never recorded twice.
schema.title: Idempotency-Key

200.description: A retry with the same Idempotency-Key: the payment that was already recorded, unchanged. Nothing new was created.

409.description: The Idempotency-Key was already used for a different bill or amount.

get.description: Receipt for one instalment, with the figures as they stood once it was paid.

post.description:
Record money given back against a payment: any amount up to what is left of it,
with a reason. It gets its own REF- receipt number and reduces what counts as paid.
A voided payment cannot be refunded.

parameters.description: Required. A unique value (8 to 64 letters, digits, `.`, `_` or `-`) per refund. Send the same value when retrying so money is never given back twice.
parameters.name: idempotency-key

schema.description: Required. A unique value (8 to 64 letters, digits, `.`, `_` or `-`) per refund. Send the same value when retrying so money is never given back twice.
schema.title: Idempotency-Key

200.description: A retry with the same Idempotency-Key: the refund that was already recorded, unchanged. Nothing new was created.

404.description: No such payment on that bill.

409.description: The payment is voided, or the Idempotency-Key was already used for a different payment or amount.

422.description: The amount is more than what is left of the payment, or the reason or the Idempotency-Key is missing or invalid.

post.description:
Void a payment entered by mistake. It stays in the bill's history, marked voided
with who, when and why, and no longer counts toward what has been paid. Repeating
the call changes nothing and keeps the first reason.

404.description: No such payment on that bill.

422.description: The reason is missing or not 5 to 200 characters.

get.description: Printable receipt data for a bill; a parent only gets their own child's.
Printable data for a refund; a parent only gets their own child's.

schema.title: Response Health Api V1 Health Get

get.description:
For deploy gates: the database answers and its schema is at the expected
migration. Failures are generic; the log says which check failed.

schema.title: Response Ready Api V1 Health Ready Get

get.description: No login needed. Counts of active students, teachers and classes only.

429.description: Too many requests; see the Retry-After header.

get.description: Admins see every score; teachers only scores for classes and subjects they teach.

put.description: Create (201) or change (200) one score; repeating the same score is a no-op.

get.description: Admins see every student; teachers only those in their assigned classes.

schema.title: Response List Parents Api V1 Students  Student Id  Parents Get

get.description:
Printable term sheet with every subject. Admins and a student's linked parents
only: teachers see their own subjects through the student results endpoint.

A student's scores for a term: all subjects for admins and linked parents, only
the caller's own subjects for teachers.

schema.title: Response List Subjects Api V1 Subjects Get

get.description: Terms, newest academic year first and First to Third Term within a year.
Accounts by email. `q` matches part of the email; no credential is ever shown.

patch.description:
Disable or re-enable an account. Disabling ends its sessions. You cannot disable
yourself or the last active administrator (409).

post.description:
Issue a one-time reset code to hand to a user who cannot sign in. It is shown
once and expires; issuing another voids it. Not for your own account (409), nor for
a disabled one (409).
